audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gives Nautilus level 1, level 6 and 2+ items and only 'Skill' at first item; the audited Nautilus side reads Skill at level 1, Skill at 4-5 and 6, and Vayne at first item and 2+ items.
audit.why: The mirror is mechanically right: Vayne's %HP true damage scales past a tank's resists, and level 1 with a 1150-range hook is a coinflip on one skillshot, not a Nautilus win. The directions must agree or mirror-fix overwrites this page.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 4, 5, 6 flipped to Skill, Skill, Vayne, Vayne as one paired group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentions Titan's Wrath, and both displacement tools go unstated as a race.
audit.why: Titan's Wrath is a flat 12s shield that also makes his attacks tick damage — it eats exactly the three-hit burst Vayne needs. And both sides carry displacement: Condemn (550, 20s at rank 1) against Dredge Line (1150, 14s at rank 1); whoever lands it first owns the trade.
audit.corrected: Force Titan's Wrath out before committing; sidestep Dredge Line and he has no engage until it returns.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and spikes[1] both claim Final Hour's stealth dodges Depth Charge.
audit.why: Riot's text has Depth Charge chase a chosen opponent from 825 range; whether invisibility breaks that lock is not in the kit file and needsResearch is empty, which means unknown. Asserting it is exactly the kind of claim that gets a player killed.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the verifiable part: Depth Charge's 825 range and 120/100/80s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1] and whys[2] describe Vayne winning levels 2 and 3 while both rows say Nautilus.
audit.why: Levels 2-3 are his: Titan's Wrath shields the trade, Staggering Blow roots on his first attack, and Riptide slows three times from 600.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten around Titan's Wrath, Staggering Blow and Riptide.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block carries no numbers.
audit.why: Dredge Line 14/13/12/11/10s, Titan's Wrath flat 12s, Riptide 7 down to 5s, Depth Charge 120/100/80s. The whole matchup is stepping up in the hook's downtime.

edits.before: Vayne out-ranges Nautilus at level 1 and punishes any hook whiff.
edits.after: Dredge Line reaches 1150; one landed hook flips level 1 on you.

edits.before: Silver Bolts chunks his slow HP pool while you dodge Dredge Line.
edits.after: Titan's Wrath at 2 shields his burst and his passive roots you.

edits.before: Level 3 true-damage procs shred his tanky start as you kite.
edits.after: Riptide at 3 slows you three times over from 600 range.

edits.before: Final Hour stealth dodges Depth Charge and punishes its long cooldown.
edits.after: Depth Charge chases you from 825 range and costs him 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Final Hour's stealth and Tumble resets let you juke his Depth Charge ult and Dredge Line, then punish the long cooldown with three Silver Bolts.
edits.after: Final Hour's faster Tumble and stealth break his Dredge Line pattern; Depth Charge is 120s at rank 1 — punish the miss with three Silver Bolts.

edits.before: AA-tumble-AA on Nautilus's step-up, proc the third silver bolt for true damage, and walk away before he reaches you.
edits.after: Dredge Line flies 1150 and is down 14s at rank 1 — sidestep it and he has no engage at all until it returns.

edits.before: Nautilus wastes Dredge Line (Hook) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Titan's Wrath is a flat 12s shield — force it out, then commit your burst.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Staggering Blow roots you on his first attack, and Riptide slows after.

edits.before: - Nautilus Dredge Line: matchup-defining — His engage. Dodge or condemn it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Dredge Line: 14s at rank 1, 1150 range — his only engage; once it is gone, step up. - Titan's Wrath: flat 12s shield, force it first. - Riptide: 5s at rank 5. - Final Hour: 100s — kill windows only.

notes: suspectName on spikes[1] ('Final Hour's') is a false positive — Final Hour is Vayne's real R. Left unedited: wants.foe[1] claims minions block your 'Condemn escape'. Condemn is a targeted knockback, not an escape, and whether minions block the target's collision path is not in the kit text; flagged rather than rewritten.
